title: Bald Men & Bouquets
description: Mr. Steve, Mr. Mike, and Rick love flowers and build beautiful bouqets in their floral shop.
quote: I think it’s pretty when they are lumped together liked this.
altHero: Mr. Steve and Mr. Mike, two bald men in blue turtlenecks, holding flowers
alt1: hands holding two big bouquets with bows on them
alt2: Mr. Steve looking disapprovingly at Rick
alt3: Rick smiling and holding a flower, Mr. Steve and Mr. Mike looking at each other disgusted
alt4: Mr. Mike making a kissy face at a fake bird
